note: WebSearch returned result titles and links only (no snippets), so web results were judged by title, and nothing was opened. The queue's species are the pigeon tremex (Tremex columba) and T. fuscicornis. The harvest's genus queries returned faunistic lists, forestry and entomology books, phylogenies of the basal Hymenoptera, a study of hymenopteran head-capsule characters and sawfly taxonomy, and no study of a Tremex eye. "Tremex visual acuity" returned human acuity-testing pages (StatPearls, EyeWiki, Iowa), patents and an arXiv paper on a human acuity test, and no insect. "pigeon tremex visual acuity" returned studies of the visual acuity of the domestic pigeon (PubMed, MDSOAR, Thieme and PMC records), a chapter of Sturkie's Avian Physiology on eye shape and acuity and a Tufts page on avian visual cognition, all on the bird. Main holds the species of Land 1997 (78 taxa), Feller et al. 2021 (383 taxa) and Caves et al. 2018 (45 taxa), searched by genus name, and none is a Tremex species; main's siricid rows are spectral rows for Sirex noctilio and Urocerus gigas. Cronin et al. 2014 and, for interommatidial_deg, Warrant and Nilsson 2006 are books that are not in hand. receptor_classes is held back on the wanted list for the 2022 survey of insect visual opsin genes (BMC Ecology and Evolution), whose species list main has not read, and for the 2022 review of Symphyta chemical and visual ecology, so this unit writes no receptor_classes record for Tremex.
